<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ja">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>Legend防衛</title>
<style>/* Wood-and-parchment mobage palette: dark wood header chrome, tan parchment panels, blue link-
   style filters, green stat text, red category tags - matching the reference's UI chrome
   (a generic RPG shop/quest-book visual language, not any of the reference's own art or text). */
:root {
  --parchment: #ECDDB0;
  --panel: #F6ECD0;
  --line: #C9AF7C;
  --wood: #3E2A16;
  --wood-mid: #6B4A28;
  --ink: #3A2E1E;
  --dim: #8A7550;
  --link: #2456C4;
  --good: #2E8B3D;
  --shu: #C43A2E;
  --gold: #B5822C;
  --display: "Hiragino Mincho ProN", "Yu Mincho", serif;
  --sans: "Hiragino Sans", "Yu Gothic", sans-serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
html, body {
  margin: 0; padding: 0; min-height: 100%;
  background: var(--parchment); color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--sans); touch-action: manipulation; overscroll-behavior: none;
}
button { font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
.view { display: none; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; min-height: 100vh; padding: 0 0 28px; }
.view.active { display: flex; }

.titlebar {
  width: 100%; background: var(--wood); color: #F3E6C4; text-align: center;
  padding: 12px 12px; font-family: var(--display); font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  border-bottom: 3px solid var(--wood-mid); position: relative;
}
.titlebar .muteBtn { position: absolute; right: 10px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); }
.wrap { width: 100%; max-width: 520px; padding: 12px; margin: 0 auto; }

.title { font-family: var(--display); font-size: 26px; margin: 10px 0 2px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-align: center; }

.bar { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 8px; }


.btn { padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 13px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); }
.btn.primary { background: var(--shu); color: #fff; border-color: var(--shu); font-weight: 700; }
.btn.on { background: var(--good); color: #fff; border-color: var(--good); font-weight: 700; }
.btn.sm { padding: 6px 10px; font-size: 11.5px; }
.btn.link { background: none; border: none; color: var(--link); text-decoration: underline; padding: 4px 6px; }
.btn.link.on { color: var(--shu); font-weight: 700; }
.btn:disabled { opacity: 0.38; cursor: default; }

/* wood-plank menu buttons, 2x2 grid, matching the reference home screen's menu */
.menu { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 10px; width: 100%; max-width: 420px; margin: 0 auto; }
.menu button { padding: 16px 8px; border-radius: 10px; border: 2px solid var(--wood-mid); background: linear-gradient(180deg, #8A6238, var(--wood)); color: #F3E6C4; }
.menu button .k { font-family: var(--display); font-size: 16px; display: block; }
.menu button .s { font-size: 10.5px; color: #D8C49A; margin-top: 3px; display: block; }

.list { width: 100%; max-width: 520px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.card { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px; }
.card h3 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-family: var(--display); font-size: 15px; }
.card .s { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--dim); line-height: 1.6; }
.card .row { display: flex; gap: 7px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; margin-top: 8px; }
.card.locked { opacity: 0.5; }

/* two-column quest card: enemy list left, reward breakdown right - matching the reference 任務 screen */
.card .cols2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px; }
.card .cols2 .enemies .tag { display: block; margin: 2px 0; }
.card .cols2 .rewards div { font-size: 11px; color: var(--good); margin: 2px 0; }
.card .cols2 .rewards div.zeni { color: var(--gold); }

/* shop-style list item: icon + blue link name + green stat line, matching the reference 武器屋 */
.shop-item { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.shop-item:first-child { border-top: none; }
.shop-item .ic { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; flex: none; margin-top: 2px; }
.shop-item .ic.lg { width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.2); background: var(--parchment); object-fit: cover; }
.shop-item .name { color: var(--link); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; }
.shop-item .stat { color: var(--good); font-size: 11.5px; margin-top: 2px; }

/* Mobile-first battle screen: field + two corner controls. No hidden tap sheets or header HUD. */
#v-battle {
  background: #68A33D;
  padding: 0;
  min-height: 100svh;
  width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.battle-head {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 520px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f7f2df 0%, #efe5c5 100%);
  border-bottom: 1px solid #c8b681;
  padding: 6px 10px 7px;
}
.battle-roster {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 3px 14px;
}
.battle-member {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  min-width: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.25;
}
.battle-member b {
  overflow: hidden;
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}
.battle-num {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex: none;
  border-radius: 50%;
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.35);
}
.slot-1 .battle-num { background:#cf2f2f; }
.slot-2 .battle-num { background:#28a843; }
.slot-3 .battle-num { background:#2e8ed0; }
.slot-4 .battle-num { background:#d87524; }

.battle-stage {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 520px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  position: relative;
}
#board {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  margin: 0;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 0;
  touch-action: none;
  background: #d4c59a;
}
.battle-controls {
  position: absolute;
  inset: auto 7px 7px 7px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-end;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.battle-controls .btn {
  pointer-events: auto;
  min-width: 74px;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 5px 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.32);
}
.battle-controls .retire {
  background: rgba(236,214,165,.92);
  border-color: #9e7746;
  color: #a63a2e;
}
.battle-controls .speed {
  min-width: 52px;
  background: rgba(42,34,24,.78);
  border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.35);
  color: #fff5d8;
}

.quest-intel {
  margin-top: 7px;
  padding: 5px 7px;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--gold);
  background: rgba(181,130,44,.08);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.75;
}
.quest-intel.goodline {
  border-left-color: var(--good);
  background: rgba(46,139,61,.07);
}
.quest-intel b {
  display: inline-block;
  min-width: 50px;
  color: var(--dim);
}
.cost { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; }


/* job-tree diagram: icon + name nodes, children indented under a connector line and a Lv/exam
   gate label, matching the reference's branching tree structure. Tappable nodes (a job the
   selected hero can transfer into right now) are highlighted; the hero's current job is marked
   separately; everything else is a plain, non-interactive reference entry. */
.tree-root { padding: 16px 14px; }
.tree-node { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 7px 4px; border-radius: 10px; }
.tree-node.hybrid { flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 12px 4px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; }
.tree-node.hybrid:first-child { border-top: none; }
.tree-icon { width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 7px; flex: none; border: 2px solid var(--job-color,rgba(0,0,0,0.25)); background: var(--parchment); object-fit: contain; }
.tree-node.current { background: #E0D3A8; border: 2px solid var(--shu); }
.tree-node.current .tree-icon { border: 3px solid var(--shu); }
.tree-node.reachable { cursor: pointer; background: #DCEBDD; border: 2px solid var(--good); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(46,139,61,0.25); }
.tree-node.reachable .tree-icon { border: 3px solid var(--good); }
.tree-node.reachable:active { background: #C6E0C9; }
/* Locked/reference-only nodes read as visibly inactive (dimmed + desaturated) so they don't look
   like a broken tap target - this is what the president's "剣豪おせない" report turned out to be:
   the node WAS correctly non-interactive for that particular hero, it just didn't look inactive. */
.tree-node.locked { opacity: 0.5; filter: grayscale(35%); }
.tree-name { font-family: var(--display); font-size: 16px; }
.tree-node .tag.current { background: var(--shu); color: #fff; }
.tree-node .tag.go { background: var(--good); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; }
.tree-node .tag.locked { background: transparent; color: var(--dim); }
.tree-children { margin-left: 10px; padding-left: 26px; border-left: 2px solid var(--line); }
.tree-gate { font-size: 11px; color: var(--dim); margin: 4px 0; }

.ov { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(30,22,12,0.62); display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; z-index: 30; padding: 16px; }
.ov.show { display: flex; }
.ov .card { max-width: 330px; text-align: center; padding: 24px; border-radius: 14px; }
.ov h2 { font-family: var(--display); font-size: 22px; margin: 0 0 8px; }
.ov p { font-size: 13px; color: var(--dim); margin: 4px 0; }
.ov .row { justify-content: center; margin-top: 16px; }

.tag { display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: #DFCB9B; color: var(--ink); margin-right: 4px; }
.tag.good { background: #DCEBDD; color: var(--good); }
.tag.warn { background: #F3DAD3; color: var(--shu); }

.slot-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 4px; color: #fff; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; margin-right: 4px; vertical-align: middle; }


/* Original-style quest acceptance flow: guide, speech bubble, difficulty row, parchment list. */
.quest-wrap { padding-top: 8px; }
.quest-guide {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 92px 1fr;
  align-items: end;
  min-height: 112px;
  margin: 0 -12px 8px;
  padding: 10px 16px 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 20% 10%, rgba(255,236,151,.38), transparent 28%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#4f3420 0%,#6e4a2c 100%);
  border-bottom: 3px solid #2e1d10;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.quest-guide-portrait {
  width: 82px;
  height: 96px;
  border-radius: 46% 46% 12px 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(145deg,#385c29 0%,#1f351c 70%);
  border: 3px solid #172414;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 5px rgba(255,255,255,.05);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: #f3e6bd;
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 28px;
}
.quest-guide-portrait span {
  width: 46px;
  height: 38px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background:#122015;
  border:2px solid #b89545;
}
.quest-guide-bubble {
  align-self: center;
  position: relative;
  margin: 0 0 12px 10px;
  padding: 13px 14px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: #fffdf5;
  border: 2px solid #2f2419;
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.35;
  color: #2f2419;
}
.quest-guide-bubble:before {
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  left:-11px;
  bottom:17px;
  width:18px;
  height:18px;
  background:#fffdf5;
  border-left:2px solid #2f2419;
  border-bottom:2px solid #2f2419;
  transform:rotate(45deg);
}
.quest-difficulty-label {
  text-align:center;
  color:var(--good);
  font-weight:800;
  margin:6px 0 2px;
}
.quest-tabs {
  justify-content:center;
  gap:1px;
  margin:0 0 10px;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  padding-bottom:6px;
}
.quest-tabs .btn.link {
  font-size:13px;
  text-decoration:none;
  padding:4px 5px;
}
.quest-tabs .btn.link.on {
  color:var(--link);
  background:#e8dcc0;
  border-radius:4px;
  text-decoration:underline;
}
#questList .card {
  border-radius:0;
  border-width:1px 0 0;
  padding:10px 8px 12px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f4e6bf,#f8efd7);
}
#questList .card h3 {
  background:#b66e35;
  color:#fff4da;
  margin:-10px -8px 8px;
  padding:5px 8px;
  font-size:14px;
  text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.25);
}
/* === REBUILD V2 ORIGINAL-MOBILE UI PASS === */
:root {
  --screen: #f1e8c7;
  --cream: #fffdf0;
  --brown: #5a3605;
  --brown2: #b87639;
  --brown3: #e2c495;
  --blue: #1028bd;
  --green: #24a53e;
  --red: #ef251d;
  --text: #17120d;
}
html, body {
  background: #24170b;
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: "Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN","Yu Gothic",sans-serif;
}
body { min-width: 280px; }
.view {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 568px;
  min-height: 100svh;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 0 18px;
  background: var(--screen);
  box-shadow: 0 0 22px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
}
.titlebar {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 38px;
  padding: 5px 44px 6px;
  background: #513600;
  border: 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #2d1d00;
  color: #fff;
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 21px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  line-height: 1.25;
}
.back-link {
  position: absolute;
  left: 6px;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  width: 36px;
  height: 30px;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: #fff6cf;
  font-size: 23px;
  line-height: 30px;
  padding: 0;
}
.titlebar .muteBtn {
  right: 6px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45);
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,.18);
  color:#fff8de;
  padding:4px 7px;
}
.wrap {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 568px;
  padding: 8px 8px 14px;
}
.list {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 568px;
  gap: 0;
}
.card {
  border-radius: 0;
  border: 0;
  border-top: 1px solid #d2b88b;
  background: #fff9e4;
  padding: 10px 8px;
}
.card:first-child { border-top: 0; }
.card h3 {
  margin: 0 0 5px;
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.card .s { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.55; color:#5e5141; }
.btn {
  border-radius: 2px;
  border: 1px solid #9f865d;
  background: linear-gradient(#fffdf2,#eadbbb);
  color:#2c2114;
}
.btn.primary {
  background: linear-gradient(#d86d51,#b8432e);
  border-color:#8d2a1e;
}
.btn.link {
  color: var(--blue);
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  text-decoration: underline;
  font-size: 15px;
  padding: 2px 4px;
}
.tag {
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: transparent;
  padding: 0 2px;
  margin-right: 2px;
  font-size: 11px;
}
.tag.good { background: transparent; color: var(--green); }
.tag.warn { background: transparent; color: var(--red); }
.tag.locked { color:#918676; }

/* HOME / MYPAGE */
#v-home { padding-bottom: 0; }
.home-title { font-size: 17px; }
.home-hero {
  height: 245px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(118,197,244,.96) 0 40%,rgba(190,221,124,.96) 41% 100%);
  border-bottom: 1px solid #a7986d;
}
.home-hero:before {
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  left:-8%; right:-8%; top:39%;
  height:42px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#7395c1 0 18%,#eff3d3 20% 28%,#8fc857 30% 100%);
  clip-path: polygon(0 54%,12% 34%,22% 50%,34% 18%,47% 48%,58% 24%,69% 52%,82% 23%,100% 48%,100% 100%,0 100%);
  opacity:.72;
}
.home-class {
  position:absolute;
  z-index:3;
  left:34px;
  top:48px;
  width:180px;
  text-align:center;
  text-shadow:0 2px 0 #fff,0 -1px 0 #fff,1px 0 0 #fff,-1px 0 0 #fff;
}
.home-job-name {
  font-size:36px;
  line-height:1;
  font-weight:900;
  color:#952d24;
  font-family:var(--display);
}
.home-job-sub {
  margin-top:2px;
  font-size:15px;
  font-weight:800;
  color:#342820;
}
.home-class-ribbon {
  display:inline-block;
  margin-top:7px;
  padding:2px 10px;
  background:#705231;
  color:#fff9d7;
  border:1px solid #3c2a17;
  text-shadow:none;
  font-size:11px;
}
.home-hero-art {
  position:absolute;
  z-index:2;
  right:4px;
  bottom:-5px;
  width:54%;
  height:94%;
  object-fit:contain;
  object-position:center bottom;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.22));
}
.home-status {
  background:#f5eac8;
  border-top:1px solid #c9b889;
  border-bottom:1px solid #bca879;
  font-size:13px;
}
.home-status > div {
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:60px 1fr 68px 1fr;
  min-height:31px;
  align-items:center;
  border-top:1px solid #ded0aa;
}
.home-status > div:first-child { border-top:0; }
.home-status > .wide { grid-template-columns:64px 1fr; }
.home-status span {
  padding-left:8px;
  color:#2e251b;
}
.home-status b {
  font-weight:500;
  text-align:right;
  padding-right:10px;
}
.home-bonus {
  min-height:28px;
  padding:5px 8px;
  background:#fff9e6;
  border-bottom:1px solid #d8c79c;
  color:#6d5632;
  font-size:11px;
  text-align:center;
}
.home-menu {
  width:100%;
  max-width:none;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:0;
  margin:0;
  background:#fff;
  border-top:5px solid #eadfbd;
}
.home-menu button {
  min-height:72px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:10px;
  padding:8px 12px;
  border:0;
  border-right:1px solid #cdbf9e;
  border-bottom:1px solid #cdbf9e;
  border-radius:0;
  background:#fffefa;
  color:#2b2013;
  text-align:left;
}
.home-menu button:nth-child(2n) { border-right:0; }
.home-menu button:active { background:#f4ecd5; }
.home-menu .menu-seal {
  width:43px;
  height:43px;
  flex:none;
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  border-radius:50%;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,#6e4c24,#3c2812);
  border:3px double #d5b778;
  color:#fff0bd;
  font-size:19px;
  font-family:var(--display);
}
.home-menu b {
  display:block;
  color:#40270f;
  font-size:18px;
  line-height:1.1;
}
.home-menu small {
  display:block;
  margin-top:3px;
  color:#887458;
  font-size:10px;
}

/* QUEST */
.quest-wrap { padding:0 0 12px; }
.quest-guide {
  min-height:215px;
  margin:0;
  padding:0;
  display:block;
  position:relative;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 14% 22%,rgba(255,224,72,.48) 0 5%,transparent 11%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 84% 20%,rgba(255,224,72,.42) 0 5%,transparent 11%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#684326,#3d2719);
  border:0;
}
.quest-guide:after {
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  left:0; right:0; bottom:0;
  height:44%;
  background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(255,255,255,.03) 0 2px,rgba(0,0,0,.03) 2px 4px),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#705033,#5b3a24);
  z-index:0;
}
.quest-guide-portrait {
  position:absolute;
  z-index:1;
  left:50%;
  transform:translateX(-50%);
  top:4px;
  width:190px;
  height:165px;
  border:0;
  border-radius:0;
  background:transparent;
  overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:none;
}
.quest-guide-portrait img {
  width:100%;
  height:100%;
  object-fit:contain;
  object-position:center bottom;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.34));
}
.quest-guide-bubble {
  position:absolute;
  z-index:3;
  left:0; right:0; bottom:-1px;
  margin:0;
  padding:17px 8px 18px;
  min-height:74px;
  border:2px solid #21190f;
  border-radius:20px;
  background:#fff;
  font-size:22px;
  font-family:var(--sans);
  color:#17120e;
}
.quest-guide-bubble:before {
  left:66px;
  top:-10px;
  bottom:auto;
  width:20px; height:20px;
  background:#fff;
  border-left:2px solid #21190f;
  border-top:2px solid #21190f;
  border-bottom:0;
  transform:rotate(45deg);
}
.quest-difficulty-label {
  margin:0;
  padding:22px 0 2px;
  background:#edf0c7;
  color:#28a842;
  font-size:21px;
  font-weight:800;
}
.quest-tabs {
  margin:0;
  padding:0 4px 14px;
  min-height:70px;
  display:flex;
  justify-content:center;
  align-content:flex-start;
  gap:0;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  background:#edf0c7;
  border-bottom:8px solid #e4d6af;
}
.quest-tabs .btn.link {
  font-size:20px;
  line-height:1.25;
  color:#17120e;
  text-decoration:none;
  padding:1px 2px;
}
.quest-tabs .btn.link.on {
  background:transparent;
  color:#0c2ac0;
  text-decoration:underline;
}
.quest-tabs .btn.link[data-qtab="eq"] { color:#ee211b; }
.quest-tabs .btn.link[data-qtab="chain"] { color:#ee211b; }
.tag.chain { background:#d9e8c8; color:#245a2c; border-color:#9abb7b; }
#questList .card {
  margin:0;
  border:0;
  border-bottom:2px solid #fff;
  background:#ead7c1;
  padding:0 8px 10px;
}
#questList .card h3 {
  margin:0 -8px 8px;
  padding:4px 8px 5px;
  background:#b8783f;
  color:#fff;
  font-size:18px;
  font-weight:500;
  text-shadow:0 1px 1px #6d3a13;
}
.quest-main {
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1.08fr;
  gap:10px;
  font-size:13px;
}
.quest-main .enemies .tag {
  display:block;
  color:#151515;
  font-size:14px;
  line-height:1.45;
}
.quest-main .rewards {
  font-size:14px;
  line-height:1.55;
}
.quest-main .rewards > div { color:#121212; }
.quest-main .rewards .zeni { color:#111; }
.quest-main .rewards .defended {
  color:#ef281e;
  font-size:17px;
  font-weight:800;
}
.quest-intel {
  margin:5px 0 0;
  padding:4px 5px;
  border:0;
  border-top:1px solid #d0b899;
  background:transparent;
  color:#453721;
  font-size:11px;
  line-height:1.45;
}
.quest-intel.goodline {
  margin-top:0;
  border-left:0;
  background:transparent;
  color:#207f30;
}
.quest-intel b { min-width:48px; color:#6a5438; }
.quest-action {
  text-align:right;
  padding-top:5px;
}
.quest-action .btn.link {
  font-size:18px;
  font-weight:700;
}

/* SHOP / EQUIPMENT */
.shop-guide {
  min-height:185px;
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(105,66,34,.15),rgba(33,20,10,.22)),
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,#8c6542 0 20px,#7d593b 21px 22px);
}
.shop-guide:before {
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  left:0; right:0; top:50px;
  height:4px;
  background:#3c2718;
  box-shadow:0 48px 0 #3c2718;
}
.shop-guide-art {
  position:absolute;
  z-index:1;
  left:50%;
  top:2px;
  transform:translateX(-50%);
  width:190px;
  height:135px;
}
.shop-guide-art img {
  width:100%;
  height:100%;
  object-fit:contain;
  object-position:center bottom;
}
.shop-guide-bubble {
  position:absolute;
  z-index:2;
  left:0; right:0; bottom:0;
  min-height:64px;
  padding:12px 10px;
  background:#fff;
  border:2px solid #20170f;
  border-radius:17px 17px 0 0;
  color:#17120e;
  font-size:17px;
  line-height:1.4;
}
.party-picker {
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
  background:#f5eccf;
  border-bottom:6px solid #e6d8b4;
}
.party-slot {
  min-height:48px;
  padding:4px 2px;
  border:0;
  border-right:1px solid #baa67b;
  background:#f5eccf;
  color:#4c3a24;
  font-size:10px;
}
.party-slot:last-child { border-right:0; }
.party-slot > span {
  display:inline-flex;
  width:19px;height:19px;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  margin-right:2px;
  border-radius:50%;
  background:#555;
  color:#fff;
  font-weight:800;
}
.party-slot.slot-1 > span { background:#cf2f2f; }
.party-slot.slot-2 > span { background:#28a843; }
.party-slot.slot-3 > span { background:#2e8ed0; }
.party-slot.slot-4 > span { background:#d87524; }
.party-slot b { display:block; margin-top:2px; font-size:11px; }
.party-slot.on { background:#dfd0aa; box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 0 #6d4a1e; }
.shop-wrap { padding:0 8px 12px; }
.shop-character {
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:94px 1fr;
  gap:8px;
  min-height:110px;
  align-items:center;
  padding:6px 2px;
  background:#fff9e4;
  border-bottom:1px solid #cdb98e;
}
.shop-character img {
  width:92px;
  height:104px;
  object-fit:contain;
  object-position:center bottom;
}
.shop-character > div span {
  display:block;
  margin-top:3px;
  font-size:11px;
  color:#5e503d;
}
.shop-character > div > b {
  display:block;
  font-size:17px;
  color:#3c260c;
}
.shop-tabs {
  padding:5px 0;
  text-align:center;
  background:#fff;
  color:#17120e;
  font-size:15px;
  border-bottom:5px solid #5b3505;
}
.shop-tabs b { color:#1120a9; text-decoration:underline; }
.shop-section-title {
  margin:0 -8px;
  padding:4px 8px;
  background:#5b3505;
  color:#fff;
  font-size:15px;
  text-align:center;
}
.shop-row {
  width:100%;
  min-height:58px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:8px;
  padding:6px 3px;
  border:0;
  border-bottom:1px solid #d0bf99;
  background:#fffdf0;
  text-align:left;
  color:#17120e;
}
.shop-row:disabled { opacity:.48; }
.shop-row-main {
  min-width:0;
  flex:1;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
}
.shop-name {
  color:#1225b0;
  font-size:14px;
  font-weight:700;
}
.shop-stat {
  margin-top:2px;
  color:#1d9e3d;
  font-size:12px;
  line-height:1.35;
}
.shop-need {
  margin-top:2px;
  color:#e02b1e;
  font-size:10px;
}
.shop-price { color:#a64421; font-size:11px; }
.shop-state { font-size:10px; }
.shop-state.equipped { color:#e0271d; }
.shop-state.owned { color:#1b9035; }
.shop-state.locked { color:#8a7e6c; }
.orb-gem {
  width:31px;height:31px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;
  border:2px solid #a98117;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 34% 28%,#fffbd0 0 13%,#f6ce31 18% 46%,#c37e0d 70%,#74400b 100%);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.4);
}
.weapon-thumb {
  width:56px;height:56px;object-fit:contain;flex:none;
  background:#f6e4bd;
  border:1px solid #c0a169;
}
.shop-buy {
  flex:none;
  min-width:72px;
  padding:5px 6px;
  border:1px solid #a3824f;
  background:#f5e7c5;
  color:#1423a2;
  text-decoration:underline;
}

/* TREE / TRAINING / CODEX: same old-mobile visual language */
#v-tree .wrap,#v-train .wrap,#v-servant .wrap,#v-titles .wrap,#v-codex .wrap,#v-settings .wrap {
  padding:7px 8px 14px;
}
.tree-root { padding:7px 4px; }
.tree-node {
  border-radius:0;
  padding:6px 3px;
  border-bottom:1px solid #d2bf94;
  background:#fff9e5;
}
.tree-node.current { border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #d2bf94;background:#f3e1aa; }
.tree-node.reachable { border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #d2bf94;background:#e7f1d5;box-shadow:none; }
.tree-node.locked { opacity:.52; }
.tree-icon { width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid #ad966d; }
.tree-name { color:#1727b0;font-size:15px;font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:700; }
.tree-children { margin-left:12px;padding-left:10px;border-left:2px solid #af9570; }
.tree-gate { color:#e23425;font-size:10px; }
#trainHeroPicker,#treeHeroPicker,#codexTabs {
  gap:0 !important;
  border-bottom:4px solid #5b3505;
}
#trainHeroPicker .btn,#treeHeroPicker .btn,#codexTabs .btn {
  border-radius:0;
  border-right:1px solid #bda87d;
}
.shop-item {
  min-height:58px;
  gap:8px;
  padding:7px 3px;
  border-top:0;
  border-bottom:1px solid #d1bd93;
  background:#fffdf0;
}
.shop-item .name { color:#1423ae;font-size:14px; }
.shop-item .stat { color:#229a3c;font-size:12px; }
.shop-item .ic.lg { width:50px;height:50px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid #b49b6e; }

/* BATTLE WIDTH + REFERENCE DENSITY */
#v-battle,.battle-head,.battle-stage { max-width:568px; }
.battle-head { padding:4px 8px 5px; }
.battle-roster { gap:2px 18px; }
.battle-member { font-size:14px; }
.battle-num { width:21px;height:21px;font-size:12px; }

/* OVERLAY */
.ov { max-width:none; }
.ov .card {
  width:min(92vw,420px);
  border:2px solid #3b2916;
  border-radius:4px;
  background:#fffdf0;
}
.ov h2 { font-family:var(--sans); }

/* Final shop-tab/target refinements after mobile preview QA */
.shop-tab {
  border:0;
  padding:0 2px;
  background:transparent;
  color:#17120e;
  font:inherit;
}
.shop-tab.on {
  color:#1120a9;
  text-decoration:underline;
  font-weight:700;
}
.shop-target {
  min-height:34px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:7px;
  padding:5px 8px;
  background:#fff9e4;
  border-bottom:1px solid #cdb98e;
  color:#4c3a24;
  font-size:11px;
}
.shop-target b {
  margin-right:auto;
  color:#3c260c;
  font-size:14px;
}
.shop-target > span:not(.slot-badge) {
  white-space:nowrap;
}
@media (max-width:360px) {
  .home-job-name { font-size:31px; }
  .home-class { left:18px; width:150px; }
  .quest-guide-bubble { font-size:19px; }
  .quest-tabs .btn.link { font-size:17px; }
  .shop-target { gap:4px; font-size:10px; }
}

/* Exact two-row quest selector from reference layout */
.quest-tabs {
  display:block;
  text-align:center;
}
.qdiff-row {
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.qspecial-row {
  margin-top:4px;
  text-align:center;
  font-size:18px;
  color:#17120e;
}
.qsep {
  font-size:19px;
  color:#17120e;
  line-height:1;
}
.quest-tabs .emergency { color:#ee211b; }
.quest-tabs .emergency.on { color:#ee211b; font-weight:800; }
.quest-tabs .chain.on { color:#ee211b; font-weight:800; }

/* Training list */
#trainHeroPicker {
  display:grid !important;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
  border-bottom:6px solid #e6d8b4 !important;
}
#trainBar {
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:10px;
  max-width:none;
  margin:0;
  padding:7px 8px;
  background:#fff9e4;
  border-bottom:5px solid #5b3505;
  color:#4c3a24;
  text-align:left;
}
#trainBar b { margin-right:auto; font-size:14px; color:#3c260c; }
#trainBar span { font-size:11px; white-space:nowrap; }
#trainMsg {
  margin:0;
  padding:5px 8px;
  min-height:27px;
  background:#fffdf0;
  color:#c43a2e !important;
  border-bottom:1px solid #d1bd93;
}
.training-row {
  min-height:62px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:8px;
  padding:7px 6px;
  background:#fffdf0;
  border-bottom:1px solid #d1bd93;
}
.training-mark {
  width:38px;
  height:38px;
  flex:none;
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  border-radius:50%;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,#6e4c24,#3c2812);
  border:3px double #d5b778;
  color:#fff0bd;
  font-family:var(--display);
  font-size:16px;
}
.training-main {
  min-width:0;
  flex:1;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
}
.training-main b {
  color:#1423ae;
  font-size:14px;
}
.training-main b em {
  color:#229a3c;
  font-style:normal;
  font-size:10px;
}
.training-main small {
  margin-top:3px;
  color:#5e503d;
  font-size:11px;
}
.training-row .btn.link {
  flex:none;
  font-size:14px;
}

/* Shared old-mobile list chrome */
.section-bar {
  margin:0;
  padding:4px 8px;
  background:#5b3505;
  color:#fff;
  text-align:center;
  font-size:15px;
}
.record-row {
  min-height:58px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:8px;
  padding:7px 5px;
  background:#fffdf0;
  border-bottom:1px solid #d1bd93;
}
.record-row.locked { opacity:.5; }
.record-mark {
  width:34px;
  height:34px;
  flex:none;
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  border-radius:3px;
  background:#6e4c24;
  color:#fff0bd;
  border:2px double #d5b778;
  font-family:var(--display);
}
.record-main {
  flex:1;
  min-width:0;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
}
.record-main b { color:#1423ae; font-size:14px; }
.record-main small { margin-top:2px; color:#5e503d; font-size:11px; }
.record-state { flex:none; color:#8a7e6c; font-size:11px; }
.record-row.earned .record-state { color:#229a3c; font-weight:700; }

/* Quest rows tuned against surviving mobile screenshot */
.quest-enemy-row {
  min-height:26px;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:24px 1fr auto;
  align-items:center;
  gap:4px;
  color:#111;
  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.1;
}
.quest-enemy-row img {
  width:22px;
  height:22px;
  border-radius:50%;
  object-fit:cover;
  border:1px solid #4a443b;
  background:#eee4c4;
}
.quest-enemy-row b {
  color:#5728c4;
  font-size:15px;
  font-weight:800;
}
.quest-main .rewards > div {
  min-height:25px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:3px;
}
.quest-main .rewards .uncleared {
  color:#7f7365;
}
.qicon {
  min-width:20px;
  display:inline-flex;
  justify-content:center;
  color:#de3e2f;
  font-size:10px;
  font-weight:800;
}

/* Battle roster text follows the four original slot colours */
.battle-member.slot-1 b { color:#b32121; }
.battle-member.slot-2 b { color:#23863a; }
.battle-member.slot-3 b { color:#3a96c8; }
.battle-member.slot-4 b { color:#d87524; }

/* Battle header tuned against surviving original combat screenshot */
.battle-head {
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 16% 118%,rgba(255,255,255,.92) 0 20%,transparent 21%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 82% 112%,rgba(255,255,255,.82) 0 18%,transparent 19%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#9ed9f5 0%,#dff3fb 100%);
  border-bottom:1px solid #91bdd1;
  padding:6px 12px 7px;
}
.battle-roster {
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  column-gap:28px;
  row-gap:4px;
}
.battle-member {
  gap:7px;
  font-size:16px;
  font-weight:700;
}
.battle-num {
  width:25px;
  height:23px;
  border-radius:0;
  border:2px solid #191919;
  font-size:14px;
  line-height:1;
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.18);
}

/* Responsive proportions measured against surviving 320px-wide mobile screenshots */
.home-hero {
  height:clamp(138px,43vw,245px);
}
.home-status > div {
  min-height:clamp(24px,7vw,31px);
}
.home-status {
  font-size:clamp(11px,3.3vw,13px);
}
.home-job-name {
  font-size:clamp(28px,8.8vw,36px);
}
.home-class {
  top:clamp(28px,8vw,48px);
}
.quest-guide {
  min-height:clamp(188px,55vw,215px);
}
.quest-guide-portrait {
  width:clamp(150px,47vw,190px);
  height:clamp(132px,41vw,165px);
}
.quest-guide-bubble {
  min-height:clamp(64px,19vw,74px);
  font-size:clamp(17px,5vw,22px);
}
.shop-guide {
  min-height:clamp(165px,49vw,185px);
}
.shop-guide-art {
  width:clamp(160px,45vw,190px);
  height:clamp(116px,34vw,135px);
}

/* Dedicated NPC art framing: use the full transparent masters but crop them like the surviving UI shots */
.quest-guide-portrait img {
  width:116%;
  height:116%;
  max-width:none;
  object-fit:contain;
  object-position:center bottom;
  transform:translate(-7%,-2%);
}
.shop-guide-art {
  overflow:hidden;
}
.shop-guide-art img {
  width:114%;
  height:114%;
  max-width:none;
  object-fit:contain;
  object-position:center top;
  transform:translate(-6%,-1%);
}

/* Smartphone touch ergonomics without changing the old-mobile visual language */
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .back-link {
    width:44px;
    height:38px;
    left:2px;
  }
  .btn.link {
    position:relative;
    min-height:34px;
    display:inline-flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
  }
  .quest-action .btn.link,
  .training-row .btn.link,
  .shop-tab {
    min-height:40px;
  }
  .shop-tab {
    padding:0 10px;
  }
  .battle-controls .btn {
    min-height:40px;
  }
}

/* Unified job-progression screen */
.tree-summary {
  min-height:38px;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;
  align-items:center;
  gap:8px;
  padding:6px 8px;
  background:#fff9e4;
  border-bottom:1px solid #cfba8f;
  color:#4c3a24;
  font-size:12px;
}
.tree-summary b { color:#3c260c; }
.tree-summary span { color:#229a3c; font-weight:700; }
.tree-summary small { color:#78664d; font-size:10px; }
.tree-section { margin:0; }
.tree-wrap { padding:0 8px 14px !important; }
#treeHeroPicker {
  border-bottom:6px solid #e6d8b4;
}
#treeList .card.tree-root {
  padding:0;
  background:#fffdf0;
  border-bottom:5px solid #e6d8b4;
}

/* Screenshot-calibrated chrome: original headers are thin, dense mobile bars */
.titlebar {
  min-height:clamp(25px,7vw,34px);
  padding:clamp(2px,0.8vw,4px) 44px;
  font-size:clamp(16px,4.8vw,20px);
}
.home-title { font-size:clamp(14px,4.3vw,18px); }

/* Replace the modern round home seals with compact old-mobile emblem plates */
.home-menu .menu-seal {
  width:48px;
  height:35px;
  flex:none;
  border-radius:5px;
  border:2px solid #432b13;
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg,#efe0b1 0%,#d6b777 48%,#aa7b3f 52%,#dbc38f 100%);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,250,219,.55),
    0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6);
  color:#4a2e12;
  text-shadow:0 1px 0 #fff0bd;
  font-size:20px;
  font-weight:900;
}
.home-menu button {
  min-height:64px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg,#fffef8 0%,#fbf5e5 100%);
}
.home-menu b {
  font-family:var(--display);
  font-size:19px;
  letter-spacing:.04em;
  text-shadow:0 1px 0 #fff;
}
.home-menu small {
  color:#7f6a4e;
  font-size:10px;
}

/* Secondary screens: old mobile-RPG information strips instead of modern cards */
.sub-info {
  min-height:40px;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;
  align-items:center;
  gap:8px;
  padding:6px 8px;
  background:#fff9e4;
  border-bottom:5px solid #5b3505;
  color:#4b3923;
  font-size:12px;
}
.sub-info b { color:#3a250e; }
.sub-info span { color:#229a3c; font-weight:800; }
.sub-info small { color:#78664d; font-size:10px; }
.list-wrap { padding:0 8px 14px !important; }

.gallery-tabs {
  min-height:50px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  gap:16px;

/* FINAL REFERENCE PROPORTION PASS */

/* DEDICATED BATTLE RESULT SCREEN */

/* MAMORIBITO ORIGINAL-UI POLISH 2026-09-20 */
/* Keep the rebuild visually close to surviving 2010-2011 phone screenshots: compact brown
   chrome, sky/grass hero panel, parchment tears and minimal combat controls. */
.home-hero:after {
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  z-index:0;
  inset:0;
  pointer-events:none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 7% 17%,rgba(255,255,255,.88) 0 7%,transparent 7.5%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 14%,rgba(255,255,255,.84) 0 8%,transparent 8.5%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 74% 13%,rgba(255,255,255,.72) 0 7%,transparent 7.5%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 82% 16%,rgba(255,255,255,.78) 0 8%,transparent 8.5%);
}
.home-class,
.home-hero-art { isolation:isolate; }
.home-bonus {
  position:relative;
  margin-bottom:9px;
}
.home-bonus:after {
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  left:0;
  right:0;
  bottom:-9px;
  height:10px;
  background:#fff9e6;
  clip-path:polygon(0 0,3% 52%,6% 10%,9% 66%,12% 14%,15% 60%,18% 8%,21% 64%,24% 13%,27% 58%,30% 10%,33% 65%,36% 14%,39% 59%,42% 9%,45% 64%,48% 15%,51% 60%,54% 8%,57% 63%,60% 12%,63% 58%,66% 9%,69% 65%,72% 13%,75% 60%,78% 8%,81% 64%,84% 14%,87% 58%,90% 10%,93% 65%,96% 14%,100% 0);
}
.home-menu {
  border-top:0;
}
.home-menu button {
  min-height:68px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffefa 0%,#fbf4df 100%);
}
.home-menu .menu-seal {
  width:39px;
  height:39px;
  border-radius:4px;
  transform:rotate(-2deg);
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,#6b4927,#41290f);
  border:2px solid #9c7b48;
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #d8bd83;
  font-size:17px;
}
.home-menu button:nth-child(2n) .menu-seal { transform:rotate(2deg); }

/* The reference quest list is dense: once difficulty is chosen, the row contains only the
   quest's enemies/rewards and the receive link, without a second strategy panel. */
#questList .card {
  padding-bottom:8px;
}
.quest-action {
  margin-top:3px;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(126,91,49,.18);
}
.quest-action .btn.link {
  min-height:32px;
  padding-right:2px;
}

/* Make the battle's optional convenience controls recede into the corners. They remain usable,
   but the field reads first, like the original watch-the-defence screen. */
.battle-controls {
  inset:auto 5px 5px 5px;
  opacity:.48;
  transition:opacity .12s ease;
}
.battle-stage:hover .battle-controls,
.battle-controls:focus-within {
  opacity:.92;
}
.battle-controls .btn {
  min-width:56px;
  min-height:32px;
  padding:3px 7px;
  font-size:10px;
  border-radius:3px;
  box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.24);
}
.battle-controls .retire {
  background:rgba(248,238,205,.76);
}
.battle-controls .speed {
  background:rgba(37,31,24,.62);
}

@media (pointer:coarse) {
  .battle-controls { opacity:.62; }
  .battle-controls .btn { min-height:36px; }
}


/* MAMORIBITO HOME MENU HIERARCHY 2026-09-20 */
/* The surviving my-page screenshot gives the main actions much more visual weight than utility
   links. Keep all eight rebuild screens, but make the first four read as the primary 2x2 menu. */
.home-menu button:nth-child(-n+4) {
  min-height:74px;
}
.home-menu button:nth-child(n+5) {
  min-height:47px;
  padding:5px 10px;
  gap:7px;
  background:#f8efd8;
}
.home-menu button:nth-child(n+5) .menu-seal {
  width:29px;
  height:29px;
  font-size:13px;
  border-width:1px;
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #d8bd83;
}
.home-menu button:nth-child(n+5) b {
  font-size:14px;
}
.home-menu button:nth-child(n+5) small {
  display:none;
}
.home-menu button:nth-child(5),
.home-menu button:nth-child(6) {
  border-top:5px solid #e3d5b0;
}


/* MAMORIBITO FOUR-HERO PANEL POLISH 2026-09-20 */
.party-slot {
  position:relative;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:22px 36px 1fr;
  grid-template-rows:1fr;
  align-items:center;
  column-gap:3px;
  min-height:54px;
  padding:4px 2px;
}
.party-slot > span {

}

}

}
.shop-character {

  padding:5px 7px 5px 3px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,252,234,.96),rgba(246,232,194,.98));
}
.shop-character:after {
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  left:0;
  right:0;
  bottom:-6px;
  height:7px;
  background:#f6e8c2;
  clip-path:polygon(0 0,4% 75%,8% 15%,12% 72%,16% 11%,20% 76%,24% 14%,28% 70%,32% 10%,36% 74%,40% 13%,44% 72%,48% 11%,52% 77%,56% 14%,60% 71%,64% 10%,68% 75%,72% 12%,76% 70%,80% 14%,84% 74%,88% 11%,92% 72%,96% 14%,100% 0);
}
.shop-character img {
  width:110px;
  height:126px;
}
.shop-character > div {
  min-width:0;
}
.shop-character > div > b {
  margin-bottom:6px;
  font-size:18px;
}
.shop-character > div span:not(.slot-badge) {
  margin-top:4px;
  line-height:1.35;
}
.shop-tabs {
  margin-top:7px;
}
.tree-summary {
  grid-template-columns:42px 1fr auto;
  grid-template-rows:auto auto;
  min-height:54px;
  padding:5px 8px;
}
.tree-summary-icon {
  grid-row:1 / span 2;
  width:40px;
  height:40px;
  object-fit:contain;
  border:1px solid #ad966d;
  background:#f4e7c3;
}
.tree-summary b {
  align-self:end;
  font-size:14px;
}
.tree-summary span {
  align-self:end;
  justify-self:end;
  font-size:11px;
}
.tree-summary small {
  grid-column:2 / span 2;
  align-self:start;
  font-size:10px;
}
#trainBar {
  min-height:61px;
  gap:7px;
}
.train-avatar {
  width:46px;
  height:46px;
  flex:none;
  object-fit:contain;
  border:1px solid #ad966d;
  background:#f4e7c3;
}
.train-selected-main {
  min-width:0;
  flex:1;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  gap:3px;
}
#trainBar .train-selected-main b {
  margin:0;
  font-size:14px;
}
#trainBar .train-selected-main > span:not(.train-exp-track) {
  font-size:11px;
}
.train-exp-track {
  display:block;

  height:8px;
  overflow:hidden;
  border:1px solid #7f6b49;
  background:#2d251b;
}

  display:block;

  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#62b94a,#9bd85c);
}
@media (max-width:360px) {
  .party-slot {
    grid-template-columns:19px 25px 1fr;
  }
  .party-job-icon {
    width:24px;
    height:24px;
  }
  .party-slot b {
    font-size:9px;
  }
  .shop-character {
    grid-template-columns:86px 1fr;
  }
  .shop-character img {
    width:82px;
    height:104px;
  }
}

}
.quest-detail-enemies { padding:2px 8px 4px; }
.quest-detail-enemy {
  min-height:54px;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:46px 1fr auto;
  gap:8px;
  align-items:center;
  border-bottom:1px solid #d7c49e;
}
.quest-detail-enemy:last-child { border-bottom:0; }
.quest-detail-enemy img {
  width:42px; height:42px; object-fit:contain;
  background:#efe3c1; border:1px solid #c4ab7e;
}
.quest-detail-enemy span { display:flex; flex-direction:column; min-width:0; }
.quest-detail-enemy b { font-size:15px; color:#2d2115; }
.quest-detail-enemy small { margin-top:2px; font-size:10px; color:#79664a; }
.quest-detail-enemy strong { font-size:15px; color:#4d3922; }
.quest-detail-line {
  min-height:38px;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:70px 1fr;
  align-items:center;
  gap:7px;
  padding:6px 9px;
  border-bottom:1px solid #decca7;
  font-size:13px;
}
.quest-detail-line:last-child { border-bottom:0; }
.quest-detail-line b { color:#6a5438; }
.quest-detail-line.good span { color:#20883b; font-weight:700; }
.quest-detail-reward {
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
  text-align:center;
}
.quest-detail-reward span {
  min-height:58px;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  justify-content:center;
  border-right:1px solid #dbc7a0;
  font-size:11px;
  color:#6a573d;
}
.quest-detail-reward span:last-child { border-right:0; }
.quest-detail-reward b { margin-top:3px; font-size:16px; color:#2d2115; }
.quest-detail-actions {
  position:fixed;
  left:50%; bottom:0; transform:translateX(-50%);
  width:min(568px,100%);
  min-height:70px;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1.35fr;
  gap:8px;
  padding:9px;
  background:rgba(69,44,20,.96);
  border-top:2px solid #2a190b;
  z-index:15;
}
.quest-detail-actions .btn { min-height:50px; font-size:17px; font-weight:800; }
.quest-detail-actions .quest-cancel { background:linear-gradient(#fffdf2,#e9d8b6); }
.quest-detail-actions .quest-start {
  background:linear-gradient(#d66548,#b43c28);
  border-color:#81271b;
  color:#fff;
}


/* MAMORIBITO ORB EQUIPMENT POLISH 2026-09-20 */
.shop-orb-list {
  border-top:1px solid #cdb78e;
}
.orb-item {
  min-height:55px;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:38px 1fr 42px;
  align-items:center;
  gap:7px;
  padding:7px 4px;
}
.orb-item.equipped {
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff8d8,#f4e4ad);
  box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 #c86d2d;
}
.orb-item .shop-row-main {
  overflow:hidden;
}
.orb-item .shop-name {
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  gap:4px;
}
.orb-kind {
  display:inline-block;
  padding:1px 5px 0;
  border:1px solid #9a7137;
  border-radius:2px;
  background:#efe0bd;
  color:#593719;
  font-size:9px;
  line-height:1.45;
  text-decoration:none;
}
.orb-kind.burst {
  border-color:#b76526;
  background:#f7dfba;
  color:#9a431b;
}
.orb-kind.all {
  border-color:#7163a4;
  background:#e5def4;
  color:#57458d;
}
.orb-action {
  justify-self:end;
  min-width:38px;
  padding:3px 2px;
  border:1px solid #a68d64;
  background:#f8efd8;
  color:#2437a3;
  font-size:10px;
  font-weight:700;
  text-align:center;
  text-decoration:underline;
}
.orb-item.equipped .orb-action {
  border-color:#b25a38;
  color:#a52e20;
  background:#fff5dd;
}
.orb-item:disabled .orb-action {
  color:#8b8171;
  text-decoration:none;
}


/* MAMORIBITO QUEST CONFIRMATION META 2026-09-20 */
.quest-detail-meta {
  min-height:31px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:0;
  padding:0 7px;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:#f6ebcc;
  border-bottom:1px solid #cdb78b;
  color:#5a452c;
  font-size:11px;
}
.quest-detail-meta span {
  position:relative;
  padding:5px 9px 5px 8px;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.quest-detail-meta span + span:before {
  content:"/";
  position:absolute;
  left:-2px;
  color:#aa9165;
}
.quest-detail-meta b {
  color:#8b3f24;
  font-size:11px;
}


/* Reference cleared-mission replay label */
.quest-replay {
  margin-left:3px;
  color:#1828ad;
  font-size:.82em;
  font-weight:700;
  text-decoration:underline;
  text-shadow:none;
}


/* MAMORIBITO REFERENCE FIDELITY PASS 2026-09-20 */
.battle-head {
  padding:5px 10px 6px;
}
.battle-roster {
  column-gap:24px;
  row-gap:3px;
}
.battle-member {
  gap:6px;
  min-height:24px;
  font-size:15px;
  line-height:1.08;
  text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.75);
}
.quest-difficulty-label {
  padding-top:18px;
  font-size:19px;
  line-height:1.05;
}
.quest-tabs {
  padding-bottom:10px;
  border-bottom-width:6px;
}
.quest-tabs .btn.link {
  min-height:28px;
  font-size:18px;
  font-weight:500;
}
.qspecial-row {
  margin-top:2px;
  font-size:17px;
}
#questList .card h3 {
  padding-top:3px;
  padding-bottom:4px;
  font-size:17px;
}
.quest-main {
  gap:8px;
}
.quest-action .btn.link {
  font-size:17px;
}
.shop-guide {
  min-height:172px;
}
.shop-guide-art {
  height:124px;
}
.shop-guide-bubble {
  min-height:58px;
  padding:10px 9px;
  border-radius:15px 15px 0 0;
  font-size:16px;
}
.orb-item {
  min-height:50px;
  padding-top:5px;
  padding-bottom:5px;
}
.orb-action {
  border-radius:0;
  box-shadow:none;
}
.shop-buy {
  border-radius:0;
  box-shadow:none;
}


/* MAMORIBITO QUEST PAPER EDGE 2026-09-20 */
.quest-tabs {
  position:relative;
  margin-bottom:7px;
  border-bottom:0;
}
.quest-tabs:after {
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  z-index:2;
  left:0;
  right:0;
  bottom:-7px;
  height:8px;
  background:#edf0c7;
  clip-path:polygon(
    0 0,3% 55%,6% 9%,9% 66%,12% 17%,15% 58%,18% 8%,21% 63%,
    24% 14%,27% 58%,30% 8%,33% 65%,36% 13%,39% 59%,42% 7%,
    45% 63%,48% 15%,51% 57%,54% 8%,57% 65%,60% 13%,63% 58%,
    66% 9%,69% 64%,72% 14%,75% 59%,78% 8%,81% 64%,84% 14%,
    87% 58%,90% 9%,93% 65%,96% 14%,100% 0
  );
}
#questList {
  position:relative;
  z-index:1;
}


/* MAMORIBITO FEATURE-PHONE SHOP LINKS 2026-09-20 */
.orb-action {
  min-width:38px;
  padding:2px 0;
  border:0;
  background:transparent;
  color:#1729aa;
  font-size:11px;
  font-weight:700;
  text-align:right;
  text-decoration:underline;
}
.orb-item.equipped .orb-action {
  border:0;
  background:transparent;
  color:#c52a20;
}
.shop-buy {
  min-width:68px;
  padding:4px 2px;
  border:0;
  background:transparent;
  color:#1729aa;
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:700;
  text-align:right;
  text-decoration:underline;
}
.shop-buy:disabled {
  color:#8c8170;
  text-decoration:none;
}
.shop-row {
  background:#fffdf0;
}
.shop-row:active:not(:disabled) {
  background:#f4e5c5;
}
.shop-state {
  font-weight:700;
}
.shop-state.equipped {
  color:#d52219;
}


/* FIDELITY LOCK: battle quest title remains above names; no top gauges. */
.battle-quest-name {
  margin:-5px -10px 5px;
  padding:5px 10px 6px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#5a3b20,#3c2716);
  border-bottom:2px solid #24170d;
  color:#fff7df;
  font-size:17px;
  font-weight:800;
  line-height:1.1;
  text-align:left;
  text-shadow:0 1px 1px #1d1209;
}


/* JOB VISUAL FIDELITY 2026-09-20 */
.shop-character {
  border-left:4px solid var(--job-color,#8b7048);
}
.shop-character img {
  object-fit:contain;
  object-position:center bottom;
  background:#efe1bd;
  border:1px solid rgba(104,76,39,.28);
}
.shop-character.job-melee img { filter:saturate(1.04) contrast(1.03); }
.shop-character.job-ranged img { filter:saturate(1.03) contrast(1.02); }
.shop-character.job-scout img { filter:saturate(.98) contrast(1.06); }
.shop-character.job-magic img { filter:saturate(1.08) contrast(1.02); }
.shop-character.job-disrupt img { filter:saturate(.96) contrast(1.04); }
.shop-character.job-support img { filter:saturate(.95) brightness(1.02); }
.shop-character.tier-5 img,
.shop-character.tier-6 img {
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(219,183,77,.32);
}


/* Profession art stays readable throughout the tree: never crop signature equipment. */
.tree-node.tier-4 .tree-icon,
.tree-node.tier-5 .tree-icon { box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(169,138,69,.28); }
.tree-node.tier-6 .tree-icon { box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(217,183,77,.36); }
.tree-node.current .tree-icon { border-color:var(--shu); }
.tree-node.reachable .tree-icon { border-color:var(--good); }
</style>

<script>/* --- 10_core.js --- */
// Foundation: data access, save/load, hero progression, legend score, audio, view routing.
// All content (jobs/enemies/maps/quests/balance) lives in data/*.json, inlined at build time as
// window.GAMEDATA - see DESIGN.md section 13. No hardcoded balance numbers in code.
const D = window.GAMEDATA;
const JOBS = D.jobs, ENEMIES = D.enemies, MAPS = D.maps, QUESTS = D.quests, BAL = D.balance;

const HERO_COUNT = 4;
const START_JOBS = ['ashigaru', 'shashu', 'jumi', 'kagura'];

// Slot identity is red/green/light-blue/orange for #1-4, independent of job - a fixed,
// functional labelling scheme (not the reference's own art or text) that we reproduce exactly.
const SLOT_COLORS = ['#C32626', '#26963B', '#4AA8D8', '#D87524'];

// Orbs: a permanent collection in this recreation. One equips per hero, never wears out, and
// owned orbs can be swapped freely. This intentionally differs from the original use-count rule.
const ORBS = {
  power:  { name: 'パワーオーブ',  cost: 600,  reqQuest: 'q02', reqLegend: 20,  desc: '攻撃力 +12%', atkMul: 1.12 },
  quick:  { name: 'クイックオーブ', cost: 800,  reqQuest: 'q03', reqLegend: 40,  desc: '攻撃速度 +18%', cdMul: 0.82 },
  fly:    { name: 'フライオーブ',   cost: 750,  reqQuest: 'q02', reqLegend: 20,  desc: '飛行へのダメージ +35%', bonusVs: { flyer: 0.35 } },
  metal:  { name: 'メタルオーブ',   cost: 1000, reqQuest: 'q03', reqLegend: 40,  desc: 'メタルへのダメージ +40%', bonusVs: { metal: 0.40 } },
  demon:  { name: 'デーモンオーブ', cost: 1200, reqQuest: 'q04', reqLegend: 70,  desc: '魔物へのダメージ +40%', bonusVs: { yokai: 0.40 } },
  push:   { name: 'プッシュオーブ', cost: 1100, reqQuest: 'q04', reqLegend: 70,  desc: 'ノックバック +0.35', kbAdd: 0.35 },
  stun:   { name: 'スタンオーブ',   cost: 1400, reqQuest: 'q05', reqLegend: 100, desc: 'スタン +0.45秒', stunAdd: 450 },
  weak:   { name: 'ウィークオーブ', cost: 1400, reqQuest: 'q05', reqLegend: 100, desc: '弱体 +18%', debuffAdd: 0.18 },
  slow:   { name: 'スロウオーブ',   cost: 1600, reqQuest: 'q06', reqLegend: 140, desc: '鈍足 +22%', slowAdd: 0.22 },
  venom:  { name: 'ドクオーブ',     cost: 1600, reqQuest: 'q05', reqLegend: 100, desc: '毒 +7', poisonAdd: 7 },
  pierce: { name: 'カンツウオーブ', cost: 1800, reqQuest: 'q06', reqLegend: 140, desc: '防御貫通 +35%', pierceAdd: 0.35 },

  // 炸裂: 主標的+近接2体。爆風: 画面上の全敵へ減衰ダメージ。
  // color is presentation-only and lets the battle renderer distinguish the two orb effects.
  spark:  { name: 'スパークオーブ', cost: 2400, reqQuest: 'q07', reqLegend: 200,
            desc: '炸裂：主標的の近く2体へ45%ダメージ', area: { type: 'burst', targets: 2, multiplier: 0.45, color: '#E79032' } },
  storm:  { name: 'ストームオーブ', cost: 5000, reqQuest: 'q09', reqLegend: 350,
            desc: '爆風：主標的以外の全敵へ32%ダメージ', area: { type: 'all', multiplier: 0.32, color: '#7168C9' } },
};

// Job-tree unlock thresholds are the CURRENT job's level, not full mastery - branches open at
// Lv5/9/14/18 of the job being left, each gated by a dedicated 転職試験 exam quest.
const EVOLVE_LV = { 2: 5, 3: 9, 4: 14, 5: 18 };

// Servants (従者, DESIGN.md §19's 編成/派遣 companion system, renamed away from "仲間" - that
// word is already the 4-hero party screen's name in this build, and reusing it for a second,
// unrelated roster would be confusing). Scoped down to just the "編成: 1-3体まで同行し、配置枠
// とは別枠で支援効果を出す" half - 派遣(sending one off to boost 採取/精錬) has no target system
// since RESEARCH.md rejected both. Bought outright with gold (once each, no duplicates), then
// toggled active/inactive up to SERVANT_MAX_ACTIVE at a time; active ones apply a flat party-wide
// multiplier/bonus, separate from the per-hero orb slot and from job mastery bonuses.
const SERVANTS = {
  hikitsune: { name: '火狐', cost: 800, desc: '攻撃力 +8%', color: '#D8623F', atkMul: 1.08 },
  fuusei: { name: '風精', cost: 800, desc: '攻撃間隔 -8%', color: '#7FD0C8', cdMul: 0.92 },
  iwakoma: { name: '岩狛', cost: 1000, desc: '攻撃力 +6%', color: '#8A7550', atkMul: 1.06 },
  kodama: { name: '木霊', cost: 700, desc: '任務報酬金 +10%', color: '#6FA85E', goldMul: 1.10 },
};
const SERVANT_MAX_ACTIVE = 2;
function servantMul(key) {
  let mul = 1;
  for (const id of save.servants.active) { const v = SERVANTS[id][key]; if (v) mul *= v; }
  return mul;
}
function buyServant(id) {
  if (save.servants.owned.includes(id)) return false;
  const cost = SERVANTS[id].cost;
  if (save.gold < cost) return false;
  save.gold -= cost;
  save.servants.owned.push(id);
  persist();
  return true;
}
function toggleServant(id) {
  const active = save.servants.active;
  const at = active.indexOf(id);
  if (at >= 0) { active.splice(at, 1); persist(); return true; }
  if (active.length >= SERVANT_MAX_ACTIVE) return false;
  active.push(id);
  persist();
  return true;
}

const SAVE_VERSION = 2;
const SAVE_KEY = 'legend_boei_save_v2';
function defaultHeroes() {
  return START_JOBS.map(job => ({ job, lv: 1, exp: 0, weaponLv: 0, orb: null, history: [job] }));
}
const DEFAULT_SAVE = {
  version: SAVE_VERSION,
  gold: 0,
  legendScore: 0,         // 伝説度: cumulative, never spent, only ever grows
  heroes: null,
  mastered: [],           // jobId[] - every job any hero has ever evolved past, for party-wide bonuses
  ownedOrbs: null,        // orbId[] - permanent collection. Once acquired, never consumed.
  unlockedJobs: null,     // jobId[] - every job any hero has ever reached; any hero can freely
                          // switch into these (president: 操作キャラ全員　解放済みの職業に転職できるように)
  questCleared: {},
  enemySeen: null,        // enemyId[] - gallery discovery; recorded when an enemy actually spawns
  titles: [],
  servants: null,         // { owned: servantId[], active: servantId[] } - see SERVANTS above
  trainTickets: BAL.training.ticketMax,
  trainCount: 0,
  lastTicketAt: 0,
  muted: false,
};

// Persistence: an Artifact's localStorage does NOT reliably survive reopening the page (the
// runtime says as much - "nothing is kept unless the page publishes it"), which is exactly the
// bug the president hit (進行が保存されない). The real save lives baked into the page itself:

// build.ps1) is this page's own source with the save data left as a hole, so a running page can
// regenerate a fresh, correctly self-referencing copy of itself and publish that via the
// `artifact` capability. localStorage is kept too, but only as a same-tab/same-session nicety -
// never the thing actually relied on to survive a reopen.
let save = load();

function load() {
  try {
    const raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY));
    const s = (raw && raw.heroes && raw.version === SAVE_VERSION)
      ? { ...DEFAULT_SAVE, ...raw }
      : { ...DEFAULT_SAVE, heroes: defaultHeroes() };
    if (!s.mastered) s.mastered = [];
    if (!s.ownedOrbs) s.ownedOrbs = [];
    if (!s.unlockedJobs) s.unlockedJobs = [...START_JOBS];
    if (!s.questCleared) s.questCleared = {};
    if (!s.titles) s.titles = [];
    if (!s.servants) s.servants = { owned: [], active: [] };
    if (!s.enemySeen) s.enemySeen = [];
    for (const h of s.heroes) if (!h.history) h.history = [h.job];
    return s;
  } catch {
    return { ...DEFAULT_SAVE, heroes: defaultHeroes() };
  }
}

function persist() {
  try { localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY, JSON.stringify(save)); } catch { /* best effort */ }
}
function flushNow() { persist(); }
function resetSave() {
  save = { ...DEFAULT_SAVE, heroes: defaultHeroes(), mastered: [], ownedOrbs: [], unlockedJobs: [...START_JOBS], questCleared: {}, enemySeen: [], titles: [], servants: { owned: [], active: [] } };
  persist();
}
function discoverEnemy(id) {
  if (!id || save.enemySeen.includes(id)) return false;
  save.enemySeen.push(id);
  persist();
  return true;
}

// --- hero progression ---
function expNeeded(jobId, lv) {
  const tier = JOBS[jobId].tier;
  const base = BAL.jobExp.base[String(Math.min(tier, 5))] || 40;
  return Math.round(base * Math.pow(lv, BAL.jobExp.power));
}
function isMastered(id) { return save.mastered.includes(id); }

// Kills and training both feed the same hero-instance exp bar - each of the four is its own
// persistent character, not a shared per-job pool.
function addHeroExp(hero, amount) {
  if (hero.lv >= BAL.jobExp.maxLevel) return { leveled: 0, mastered: false };
  hero.exp += Math.round(amount);
  let leveled = 0;
  while (hero.lv < BAL.jobExp.maxLevel && hero.exp >= expNeeded(hero.job, hero.lv)) {
    hero.exp -= expNeeded(hero.job, hero.lv);
    hero.lv++; leveled++;
  }
  let mastered = false;
  if (hero.lv >= BAL.jobExp.maxLevel && !isMastered(hero.job)) {
    save.mastered.push(hero.job); mastered = true;
  }
  persist();
  return { leveled, mastered };
}

// What a hero currently at fromJob/fromLv can evolve into right now.
function evolutionsFor(fromJob, fromLv) {
  return Object.keys(JOBS).filter(id => {
    const t = JOBS[id];
    if (t.titleReq || t.questReq) return false; // special jobs are granted separately, not chosen here
    // Hybrids: only offer this as a next step to a hero whose CURRENT job is actually one of the
    // listed prerequisite lineages (not every prerequisite mastered by anyone in the party) -
    // otherwise any hero, regardless of their own job, could "転職" into an unrelated hybrid the
    // moment two OTHER heroes happened to master its prerequisites (president: この転職ボタン邪魔
    // ここで出来るのは未進化の転職のみにして - spotted on 勇者, who was showing unrelated
    // hybrid transfer buttons that had nothing to do with its own odachi->yuusha lineage).
    if (t.masterReq) return t.masterReq.includes(fromJob) && t.masterReq.every(isMastered);
    if (t.from && t.from.includes(fromJob)) {
      const lvOk = fromLv >= (EVOLVE_LV[t.tier] || 5);
      const examOk = !t.examReq || !!save.questCleared[t.examReq];
      return lvOk && examOk;
    }
    return false;
  });
}
function specialJobsAvailable() {
  return Object.keys(JOBS).filter(id => {
    const t = JOBS[id];
    if (!t.titleReq && !t.questReq) return false;
    if (t.titleReq && !save.titles.includes(t.titleReq)) return false;
    if (t.questReq && !save.questCleared[t.questReq]) return false;
    if (t.masterReq && !t.masterReq.every(isMastered)) return false;
    return true;
  });
}

// Any hero can switch into any job the party has already unlocked (reached before, by any
// hero), free and instant, alongside the normal tree-gated evolution options (president:
// 操作キャラ全員　解放済みの職業に転職できるように).
function evolveHero(hero, toJob) {
  const viaTree = evolutionsFor(hero.job, hero.lv).includes(toJob) || specialJobsAvailable().includes(toJob);
  const viaUnlocked = save.unlockedJobs.includes(toJob);
  if (!viaTree && !viaUnlocked) return false;
  if (!isMastered(hero.job)) save.mastered.push(hero.job); // the job just left behind still banks its bonus
  hero.job = toJob; hero.lv = 1; hero.exp = 0; // weaponLv/orb are the character's own gear - carries over
  if (!hero.history) hero.history = [];
  if (!hero.history.includes(toJob)) hero.history.push(toJob);
  if (!save.unlockedJobs.includes(toJob)) save.unlockedJobs.push(toJob);
  persist();
  return true;
}

// Mastered jobs grant permanent party-wide bonuses - the reason to fully master a job before
// moving on, even once evolving further is already available.
function supportTotal(id) {
  let total = 0;
  for (const jid of save.mastered) {
    const m = JOBS[jid] && JOBS[jid].master;
    if (m && m.id === id) total += m.value;
  }
  return total;
}

// --- weapons ---
// "武器強化費用" master bonus (jumi/yariashi/kunoichi/nagae/raifushi lines) used to be labelled
// refineCost/materialCost for the rejected 精錬/採取 systems (RESEARCH.md's 採用しない list) and
// did nothing - remapped onto this real, already-live cost formula instead of staying dead flavor
// text on the job tree screen.
function weaponCost(lv) {
  return Math.round(BAL.weapon.costBase * Math.pow(BAL.weapon.costPower, lv) * (1 + supportTotal('weaponCost')));
}
function upgradeWeapon(hero) {
  if (hero.weaponLv >= BAL.weapon.maxLevel) return false;
  const cost = weaponCost(hero.weaponLv);
  if (save.gold < cost) return false;
  save.gold -= cost; hero.weaponLv++;
  persist();
  return true;
}
// "オーブ購入費用" master bonus (shashu/reikyu/bukyuushi line) used to be labelled gatherBonus
// for the rejected 採取 system and did nothing - remapped onto this real, already-live cost.
function orbCost(orbId) { return Math.round(ORBS[orbId].cost * (1 + supportTotal('orbCost'))); }
function ownsOrb(orbId) { return save.ownedOrbs.includes(orbId); }
function orbRequirementsMet(orbId) {
  const o = ORBS[orbId];
  if (o.reqQuest && !save.questCleared[o.reqQuest]) return false;
  if ((o.reqLegend || 0) > save.legendScore) return false;
  return true;
}
function orbRequirementText(orbId) {
  const o = ORBS[orbId], needs = [];
  if (o.reqQuest && !save.questCleared[o.reqQuest]) {
    const q = QUESTS.find(x => x.id === o.reqQuest);
    needs.push((q ? q.name : o.reqQuest) + '突破');
  }
  if ((o.reqLegend || 0) > save.legendScore) needs.push('伝説度' + o.reqLegend);
  return needs.join(' / ');
}
function acquireOrb(orbId) {
  if (ownsOrb(orbId)) return true;
  if (!orbRequirementsMet(orbId)) return false;
  const cost = orbCost(orbId);
  if (save.gold < cost) return false;
  save.gold -= cost;
  save.ownedOrbs.push(orbId);
  persist();
  return true;
}
function equipOrb(hero, orbId) {
  if (hero.orb === orbId) return true;
  if (orbId && !ownsOrb(orbId) && !acquireOrb(orbId)) return false;
  hero.orb = orbId || null;
  persist();
  return true;
}

// --- audio ---
const sfx = (() => {
  let ac = null;
  function ctx() {
    if (!ac) { const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext; if (AC) ac = new AC(); }
    if (ac && ac.state === 'suspended') ac.resume();
    return ac;
  }
  function tone(f, dur, type, vol, when = 0, glide = null) {
    const c = ctx(); if (!c || save.muted) return;
    const t0 = c.currentTime + when;
    const o = c.createOscillator(), g = c.createGain();
    o.type = type; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f, t0);
    if (glide) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(glide, t0 + dur);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol, t0 + 0.012);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur);
    o.connect(g); g.connect(c.destination); o.start(t0); o.stop(t0 + dur + 0.02);
  }
  return {
    unlock() { ctx(); },
    ui() { tone(430, 0.06, 'triangle', 0.05); },
    buy() { tone(320, 0.09, 'triangle', 0.06); tone(480, 0.09, 'triangle', 0.045, 0.05); },
    hit() { tone(220, 0.04, 'square', 0.022); },
    kill() { tone(520, 0.07, 'triangle', 0.04); },
    leak() { tone(190, 0.24, 'sawtooth', 0.07, 0, 95); },
    level() { [523, 659, 784].forEach((f, i) => tone(f, 0.15, 'triangle', 0.07, i * 0.07)); },
    master() { [523, 659, 784, 1046, 1318].forEach((f, i) => tone(f, 0.26, 'triangle', 0.08, i * 0.09)); },
    win() { [523, 659, 784, 1046].forEach((f, i) => tone(f, 0.3, 'triangle', 0.08, i * 0.1)); },
    lose() { [400, 320, 240].forEach((f, i) => tone(f, 0.34, 'sawtooth', 0.07, i * 0.14)); },
  };
})();

// --- view routing ---
function showView(id) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(v => v.classList.toggle('active', v.id === id));
  window.scrollTo(0, 0);
}
function overlay(title, text, buttons) {
  const ov = document.getElementById('ov');
  ov.querySelector('h2').textContent = title;
  ov.querySelector('p').textContent = text;
  const row = ov.querySelector('.row');
  row.innerHTML = '';
  for (const b of buttons) {
    const el = document.createElement('button');
    el.className = 'btn' + (b.primary ? ' primary' : '');
    el.textContent = b.label;
    el.onclick = () => { ov.classList.remove('show'); b.act && b.act(); };
    row.appendChild(el);
  }
  ov.classList.add('show');
}

/* --- 15_ui_art.js --- */
// Dedicated UI NPC art generated for Rebuild V2. Embedded as WebP data URIs so the
// single-file Artifact build remains self-contained.
const UI_NPC_ART = {
  questGuide: "data:image/webp;base64,",
  shopkeeper: "data:image/webp;base64,"
};

/* --- 17_job_art_vector.js --- */
// Rebuild V3 job-art pass.
// Every profession uses original vector equipment art built around the defining
// "invisible person wearing floating gear" silhouette. No visible skin/face/body is drawn.
// This file is the single source of truth for all 37 profession visuals.
window.REBUILD_HERO_ART = window.REBUILD_HERO_ART || {};
window.MAMORIBITO_VISUAL_REV = '2026-09-22-V9-CLEAN-SINGLE-SOURCE';

(() => {
  const LINE = {
    melee:   { main:'#784b34', trim:'#d2b37a', dark:'#2d2019', cloth:'#925f45' },
    ranged:  { main:'#5c7447', trim:'#d4c58b', dark:'#263223', cloth:'#718e59' },
    scout:   { main:'#3e4c58', trim:'#b9c5cf', dark:'#171e24', cloth:'#536675' },
    magic:   { main:'#8a433f', trim:'#efc36b', dark:'#321a1b', cloth:'#a9524b' },

  const esc = s => String(s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;');

  function head(type, c, t, d) {
    const common = 'stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="8" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"';
    if (type === 'jingasa') return '<path '+common+' fill="'+c+'" d="M76 73 Q128 29 180 73 L163 88 H92Z"/><path '+common+' fill="none" d="M84 88H172"/>';
    if (type === 'kabuto') return '<path '+common+' fill="'+c+'" d="M84 82V58Q128 28 172 58V83L158 95H98Z"/><path '+common+' fill="'+t+'" d="M99 55 80 30 113 47M157 55l20-27-34 18"/><path '+common+' fill="none" d="M103 78h50"/>';
    if (type === 'hornhelm') return '<path '+common+' fill="'+c+'" d="M82 85V58Q128 31 174 58V86L158 98H97Z"/><path '+common+' fill="'+t+'" d="M96 55 68 25 105 44M160 55l29-31-38 20"/><path '+common+' fill="none" d="M103 80h52"/>';

    if (type === 'eboshi') return '<path '+common+' fill="'+c+'" d="M105 82 113 28 147 36 153 83Z"/><path '+common+' fill="'+t+'" d="M91 85H168L157 96H102Z"/>';
    if (type === 'veil' || type === 'crownveil') return '<path '+common+' fill="'+t+'" d="M95 65Q128 35 161 65L153 84H103Z"/><path '+common+' fill="'+c+'" d="M96 78 84 111 104 103M160 78l14 33-21-8"/>' + (type==='crownveil'?'<path '+common+' fill="#e7c568" d="M111 45 128 24 146 45 137 55H119Z"/>':'');
    if (type === 'cowl' || type === 'ritual' || type === 'artisan') return '<path '+common+' fill="'+c+'" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M128 27 83 84 98 103H160L174 84ZM128 57Q108 60 105 82H151Q148 60 128 57Z"/>' + (type==='ritual'?'<path '+common+' fill="'+t+'" d="M112 37 128 20 145 38 128 48Z"/>':'') + (type==='artisan'?'<path '+common+' fill="'+t+'" d="M93 49 76 58 91 69M163 49l18 9-16 12"/>':'');
    if (type === 'foxmask') return '<path '+common+' fill="'+c+'" d="M91 49 111 63Q128 54 145 63L165 48 158 91 139 106H116L97 91Z"/><path fill="'+d+'" d="M108 77l13 6-14 5ZM149 77l-13 6 14 5Z"/><path '+common+' fill="'+t+'" d="M124 94h8l-4 8Z"/>';
    if (type === 'cresthelm') return '<path '+common+' fill="'+c+'" d="M84 83V57Q128 31 172 57V84L157 96H99Z"/><path '+common+' fill="'+t+'" d="M118 48 128 18 139 48 128 59Z"/><path '+common+' fill="none" d="M104 79h48"/>';
    if (type === 'beasthelm') return '<path '+common+' fill="'+c+'" d="M85 84V59Q128 31 171 59V85L158 98H98Z"/><path '+common+' fill="'+t+'" d="M98 54 79 31 108 44M157 54l19-23-29 13"/><path '+common+' fill="none" d="M101 78h54"/>';

    return '<path '+common+' fill="'+c+'" d="M87 82Q92 43 128 40Q164 43 169 82L154 94H102Z"/>';

  function garment(kind, c, t, d, tier) {
    const common='stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="8" stroke-linejoin="round"';
    const long = kind==='longcoat'||kind==='longrobe'||kind==='legend';
    const armored = kind==='armored'||kind==='legend';
    const bottom = long ? 255 : 233;
    let s='<path '+common+' fill="'+c+'" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M95 126 112 112H144L162 126 177 '+bottom+' Q128 '+(bottom+25)+' 79 '+bottom+' Z M112 123 Q128 137 145 123 L141 153 Q128 162 115 153Z"/>';
    s+='<path '+common+' fill="'+t+'" d="M90 135 69 164 83 179 105 151M166 135l22 29-14 15-23-28"/>';
    if (armored) s+='<path '+common+' fill="none" stroke="'+t+'" d="M96 150h64M92 178h72M88 205h80"/>';
    if (tier>=4) s+='<path '+common+' fill="none" stroke="#e8c96e" stroke-width="5" d="M98 '+(bottom-15)+'Q128 '+bottom+' 159 '+(bottom-15)+'"/>';
    if (kind==='legend') s+='<path '+common+' fill="none" stroke="#f6e7a7" stroke-width="5" d="M103 132 128 145 153 132"/>';
    return s;
  }

  function glovesBoots(c,d) {

  }

  function weapon(type, c, t, d) {
    const sw=(x1,y1,x2,y2,w=9)=>'<path stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="'+(w+5)+'" stroke-linecap="round" d="M'+x1+' '+y1+' '+x2+' '+y2+'"/><path stroke="#d9dde0" stroke-width="'+w+'" stroke-linecap="round" d="M'+x1+' '+y1+' '+x2+' '+y2+'"/>';
    const hilt=(x,y)=>'<path stroke="'+t+'" stroke-width="12" d="M'+(x-13)+' '+y+'h26"/><path stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="8" d="M'+x+' '+y+'v28"/>';
    if (type==='sword'||type==='katana') return sw(66,176,24,110,8)+hilt(68,178);
    if (type==='greatblade'||type==='nodachi'||type==='ogreblade'||type==='guardianblade'||type==='herosword') return sw(72,178,15,70,type==='ogreblade'?15:11)+hilt(73,180)+(type==='herosword'?'<path fill="'+t+'" stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="5" d="M17 66 26 47 35 67 26 78Z"/>':'');
    if (type==='spear'||type==='longspear'||type==='lance') return '<path stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="13" d="M76 187 18 74"/><path stroke="'+t+'" stroke-width="7" d="M76 187 18 74"/><path fill="#d9dde0" stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="6" d="M18 74 10 38 38 63Z"/>';
    if (type==='dualsword') return sw(76,177,27,102,7)+sw(180,178,218,99,7)+hilt(77,179)+hilt(179,180);
    if (type==='kunai'||type==='dualkunai') return '<path fill="#c8cdd1" stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="6" d="M72 168 35 130 48 119 86 157Z"/><circle cx="78" cy="171" r="9" fill="none" stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="6"/>'+(type==='dualkunai'?'<path fill="#c8cdd1" stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="6" d="M181 168 218 130 205 119 167 157Z"/><circle cx="175" cy="171" r="9" fill="none" stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="6"/>':'');
    if (/bow|recurve/.test(type)) {
      let s='<path fill="none" stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="12" d="M68 88Q17 154 67 224"/><path fill="none" stroke="'+t+'" stroke-width="6" d="M68 88Q22 154 67 224"/><path fill="none" stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="3" d="M68 88 68 224"/>';
      if(type==='bowsword') s+=sw(186,177,219,109,7)+hilt(184,179);
      if(type==='poisonbow') s+='<circle cx="53" cy="213" r="10" fill="#739a52" stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="5"/>';
      if(type==='spiritbow') s+='<path fill="none" stroke="#c7f1e0" stroke-width="5" d="M48 108Q7 153 48 205"/>';
      if(type==='ritualbow') s+='<path fill="'+t+'" stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="5" d="M51 140h22v35H51Z"/>';
      return s;
    }
    if (/staff/.test(type)) {
      let s='<path stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="13" d="M73 220 56 79"/><path stroke="'+t+'" stroke-width="7" d="M73 220 56 79"/>';
      if(type==='firestaff'||type==='flamestaff') s+='<path fill="#ef7a35" stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="6" d="M57 78Q33 60 52 32 54 55 72 46 80 70 57 78Z"/>';
      else if(type==='icestaff'||type==='froststaff') s+='<path fill="#a8dff2" stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="6" d="M57 72 38 53 57 31 75 53Z"/>';
      else if(type==='thunderstaff') s+='<path fill="#e7cf5c" stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="6" d="M51 30 77 30 61 53 80 53 49 87 58 61 40 61Z"/>';
      else if(type==='sealstaff'||type==='onmyostaff'||type==='grandstaff') s+='<circle cx="56" cy="54" r="22" fill="'+c+'" stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="7"/><path fill="none" stroke="'+t+'" stroke-width="5" d="M43 54h26M56 41v26"/>';
      return s;
    }
    if(type==='fan') return '<path fill="'+c+'" stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="7" d="M73 182 30 134Q65 103 96 137Z"/><path stroke="'+t+'" stroke-width="4" d="M73 178 45 132M73 178 62 122M73 178 80 126"/>';
    if(type==='gohei'||type==='greatgohei') return '<path stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="12" d="M72 222 60 100"/><path stroke="'+t+'" stroke-width="6" d="M72 222 60 100"/><path fill="#f3efe4" stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="5" d="M59 102 31 121 49 136 26 153 55 167 72 150 48 135 75 118Z"/>'+(type==='greatgohei'?'<path fill="#f3efe4" stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="5" d="M65 104 89 120 75 136 97 151 70 166 55 149 77 135 52 118Z"/>':'');
    if(type==='ofuda'||type==='chainseal') {
      let s='<path stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="9" d="M77 204 55 111"/><g fill="#f5e7b3" stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="4"><rect x="31" y="95" width="31" height="57"/><rect x="56" y="121" width="31" height="57"/></g>';

      return s;
    }
    if(type==='puppet') return '<path stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="9" d="M33 105h76M71 89v32"/><path stroke="#8c7658" stroke-width="4" d="M45 108v55M97 108v55"/><g fill="'+c+'" stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="5"><circle cx="45" cy="174" r="13"/><path d="M34 187h22l8 31H26Z"/><circle cx="97" cy="174" r="13"/><path d="M86 187h22l8 31H78Z"/></g>';
    if(type==='gong') return '<circle cx="59" cy="143" r="42" fill="#b98735" stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="8"/><circle cx="59" cy="143" r="10" fill="'+t+'" stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="5"/><path stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="11" d="M179 115 151 184"/><circle cx="176" cy="111" r="13" fill="'+c+'" stroke="'+d+'" stroke-width="6"/>';
    return '';

    if (id==='odachi') return '<g '+common+'><path fill="'+t+'" stroke-width="7" d="M169 104 208 141 192 223 160 191Z"/><path fill="none" stroke="#d9dde0" stroke-width="8" d="M177 192 224 112"/><path fill="'+c+'" opacity=".8" stroke-width="6" d="M89 121 71 159 88 202 103 160Z"/></g>';

    if (id==='bukyuushi') return '<g '+common+'><path fill="'+t+'" stroke-width="6" d="M173 120 201 135 189 200 163 188Z"/><path fill="none" stroke="#d9dde0" stroke-width="7" d="M165 155Q200 110 221 126"/><path fill="'+c+'" stroke-width="5" d="M84 136 66 162 83 186 102 161Z"/></g>';

    if (id==='daionmyo') return '<g '+common+' fill="#f5e7b3" stroke-width="4"><path d="M186 101h23v41h-23Z"/><path d="M200 151h23v42h-23Z"/><path d="M171 201h22v41h-22Z"/></g><path fill="none" stroke="#e7d9f5" stroke-width="5" d="M40 144Q58 117 75 144Q57 170 40 144Zm134-10Q194 106 214 134Q194 160 174 134Z"/>';
